name: Pyromancer Hasty Incantation lengthens Flame Step (#970)
contract: #970: Hasty Incantation (802169) is already native: ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER op 6 (RADIUS) bp 9 die 1 = +10, mask (0,0x40,0) on Flame Step 801911/801929/803459. The module reads the dash length from 801929 effect 1 CalcRadius (20 yd base), which applies SPELLMOD_RADIUS, so the dash is 30 yd. Asserted as the native radius modifier on the 20 yd base; the travelled distance itself is not measured.
